reviewKind: AI inspection of saved actual-renderer PNGs; not a human player acceptance test
findings: The combat body is empty-handed in both mirrored firing cases. Only the independent tool remains; no second baked gun was visible.
Raised obstacles fade behind the player and retain full opacity in front, as supported by native Sprite alpha and actual texture-alpha intersection measurements.
All eight danger images retain visible boundaries, progress cues and essential captions in the inspected normal/low examples.
The five actual-alpha silhouettes are distinct as technical shapes; no new-player recognition rate is inferred.
limitations: The four occlusion and eight danger images use artificially positioned clones of a recorded real state. They are not naturally observed gameplay scenarios and have no production DOM HUD.

The mimic-corrosion derived case places the hero on the tissue node; the tissue covers much of the torso while the head, tool and foot ring remain visible. This is a recorded boundary, not proof that every actor stays unobscured.
Complete multi-direction continuous animation, missing mother/immune/FISSION artwork, human recognition and commercial incubation outcomes are not established by these images.
